annotations.text:
Four replacements for the Overview tab.

Same session data in all four, so you are comparing layout and wording, not numbers.

Everything uses the real tokens: cream #faf8f3, sand #f1ece2, ink #2b2622, coral #e0714f, Fraunces headings, Inter body.

Watch & Listen is untouched.

A · Headline
Words lead. The verdict is the biggest thing on the page, numbers sit on one hairline rule, no cards at all. The quietest option.

B · Ranked
One chart instead of six cards. Sorted worst to best with a target marker, so where you stand is obvious in one look.

C · Three Up
Reduction by selection. Only three things get a card: what to fix, what is strongest, and your fillers. The rest collapses to one line.

D · Rundown
A plain list. Every measure gets a row, a value, and one sentence explaining what it means. The most scannable on a phone.
